339-677-969-8250.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

602-3365-4691.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
602-3365-4691.description:
Activate Aeromoeba by discarding a card.
Feast of Sanity triggers, dealing 1 damage to you and causing you to gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Aeromoeba ability, switching Aeromoeba's power and toughness until end of turn
Repeat

277-2577-5231-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control another Zombie.
You control a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
277-2577-5231-7084.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Tiller Engine triggers, untapping the land.
Resolve the Thermopod ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1651-2392-2709-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Mechanics to become an artifact using Silverskin Armor.
Activate Orcish Mechanics by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Mechanics.
Repeat from step 2.

3129-4772-7858.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Hollowhenge Overlord triggers, creating four 2/2 Wolf creature tokens for each Wolf and/or Werewolf you control due to Primal Vigor and Doubling Season.
Repeat step 1 during each of your upkeeps. You'll create exponentially more Wolves each time assuming the Wolf tokens survive.
3129-4772-7858.notes: The number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you'll control after performing steps 1 and 2 is equal to 5^X * Y, where X is the number of iterations of those steps you've performed (starting at 1), and Y is the initial number of Wolves and/or Werewolves you started with. So if you start with 6 creatures, you'll have 30 after the first iteration, 150 after the second, and so on. This also assumes no Wolves and/or Werewolves die, and no more are created during the turns.

1379-3197-6830-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1379-3197-6830-6996.description:
Gain life in any way.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Encroaching Mycosynth.
Pactdoll Terror triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

3532-5078-6709-6792.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Ballad of the Black Flag's fourth chapter ability has triggered this turn
3532-5078-6709-6792.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat.

933-4377-7722.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Conjurer's Closet.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Walk the Aeons from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Walk the Aeons from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-5195-7498-7539.description:
Cast a copy of Lightning Bolt from exile by paying {R}.
Displacer Kitten and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
When Biblioplex Tomekeeper enters, it triggers, preparing Emeritus of Conflict.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}
Repeat.

4186-4384-6719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4384-6719.description:
Gain life.
Treebeard's second ability triggers, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2122-5231-7267.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1339-2122-5231-7267.description:
Activate Mindless Automaton's first ability by paying {1} and discarding a card, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Mindless Automaton's second ability by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing an Insect, adding {R}.
Repeat.

628-5147-6935.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a Spirit Detective.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Otherworldly Escort.
When Otherworldly Escort dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

985-4050-5220.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken artifact creature that can be cast using one colored mana or less.
985-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2921-4484-4871-5643-6710.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6710.notablePrerequisites: There are two cards exiled by The Kenriths' Royal Funeral.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6710.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Bartolomé del Presidio abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2921-4484-4871-5643-6710.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

2034-2043-6441-6671.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Magic Pot that are 1/1 Soldiers.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Magic Pot tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
When the Magic Pot tokens die, they trigger, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}.
Repeat.

147-6618.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature.
You have enough mana to cast Relm's Sketching
147-6618.description:
Cast Relm's Sketching by paying its mana cost, targeting a creature you control.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying {1}{R}{R}.
When Dualcaster Mage enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Relm's Sketching, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Relm's Sketching, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

3591-5437-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
3591-5437-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
3591-5437-5796-6282.description:
Activate Prognostic Sphinx by discarding a card.
Necropotence triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Prognostic Sphinx ability.
Repeat.

997-2178-3817-6542.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
997-2178-3817-6542.description:
Activate Sidisi by tapping it and sacrificing a nontoken creature with mana value 5.
When the creature dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Sidisi ability, returning Sister Hospitaller from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sister Hospitaller enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the creature with mana value 5 from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to gain 5 life.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Sister Hospitaller.
When Sister Hospitaller dies, Sidisi triggers, untapping Sidisi.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

678-5670-5758.description:
Cast Sunshower Druid by paying {G}.
When Sunshower Druid enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing Sunshower Druid
When Sunshower Druid dies, Enduring Renewal triggers, returning Sunshower Druid from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

856-5147-5632-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token and a Clue token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

1445-3967-4871-6351.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand and a creature card in your graveyard.
1445-3967-4871-6351.description:
Activate Tortured Existence by paying {B} and discarding a creature card, returning another creature card from your graveyard to your hand.
Teval triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2493-3542-6485.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{G}{U}.
2493-3542-6485.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{G}{U}.
Cast Rally the Galadhrim by paying {2}{G}{U} and tapping Archaeomancer and Palinchron, targeting Archaeomancer
Rally the Galadhrim's conspire ability triggers, copying it, targeting Palinchron.
Resolve the copy of Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve the original Rally the Galadhrim, creating a token copy of Archaeomancer.
When the Archaeomancer token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rally the Galadhrim from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, tapping the Archaeomancer and Palinchron tokens when casting Rally the Galadhrim instead.

1737-2438-4242-4853.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {4} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Su-Chi.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Su-Chi.
When Su-Chi dies, Su-Chi and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Prototype Portal.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

4321-4779-5777.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
4321-4779-5777.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing a Food.
Camellia triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token and a Food artifact token.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

1909-3291-4486.notablePrerequisites: Karametra's Acolyte does not have summoning sickness.
1909-3291-4486.description:
Activate Karametra's Acolyte by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Mirror Entity by paying {1}, giving creatures you control all creature types and base power and toughness 1/1 until end of turn.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Karametra's Acolyte.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Repeat.
1909-3291-4486.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Mirror Entity to make your creatures infinitely large until end of turn.

224-225-774-5923.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Wonderscape Sage do not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one mana-producing land.
224-225-774-5923.description:
Activate the mana-producing land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Wonderscape Sage by tapping it and returning the mana-producing land from the battlefield to your hand, causing you to draw a card and discard a card if the land didn't have a nonbasic land type.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting the mana-producing land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Stone-Seeder Hierophant and Retreat to Coralhelm trigger.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger, untapping Wonderscape Sage.
Resolve the Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping the mana-producing land.
Repeat.

42-837-1283-2440.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five other Humans and/or Clerics.
42-837-1283-2440.description:
Activate Seal of Removal by sacrificing it, returning Disciple of the Sun to your hand.
Cast Disciple of the Sun by paying {5}.
When Disciple of the Sun enters the battlefield, it and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Disciple of the Sun trigger, returning Seal of Removal from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {6}.
Cast Seal of Removal by paying {1}.
Repeat.
If you control seven or more Humans and/or Clerics, this combo nets infinite mana.

2-1057-4094-4659.notablePrerequisites: Kaya has at least two loyalty counters.
2-1057-4094-4659.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double all tokens you make this turn.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying {4}.
Brimaz's first ability triggers, creating two Incubator artifact tokens.
When Ancestral Statue enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing the two Incubators, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1447-4142-5256.description:
Cast Hostage Taker by paying {2}{U}{B}.
Hostage Taker enters the battlefield, exiling Angel of Glory's Rise.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hostage Taker.
Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, returning Angel of Glory's Rise from exile to the battlefield.
Angel of Glory's Rise enters the battlefield, returning Hostage Taker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have a large amount of Altar of Dementia abilities on the stack, you may stop the loop and resolve them to cause target player(s) to mill infinite cards.
